head: Find things to do, one swipe away
alt: Swipe deck card for the Empire State Building, a Landmark 1.1 km away and open now, with skip, go and save buttons
claim: Swipe deck of things to do near the user: Discover tab (src/pages/Discover.jsx), shown in the screen itself.

head: Bored? We'll pick for you
alt: I'm bored pick: York Guildhall, a Landmark only 60 m away, with Show another and Let's go buttons
where: central York (53.9601,-1.0850), I'm bored pick; the blurred deck card behind the sheet is York Guildhall too, the same credited photo
claim: "We'll pick for you": the I'm bored button picks one nearby place and shows it with its distance ("Only 60m away" here; an Open now chip appears only when the place's hours are known, and none shows on this screen), as in the screen.

head: A half-day out, planned in a tap
alt: Half-day plan on a York map: three numbered stops from Barley Hall at 10:20 to Brew & Brownie, with Maps, Share and Save
where: central York, Plan tab, default Mix vibe and Half day, one tap on Generate itinerary from a fresh page, page clock started at 10:00
claim: "A half-day out, planned in a tap": from the Plan tab's defaults (Mix adventure, Half day), one tap on Generate itinerary builds a timed 3-stop half-day plan with a route map (src/pages/Plan.jsx; a half day is 3 stops, src/pages/Plan/constants.ts), as in the screen.

head: See what's on this weekend
alt: What's on this weekend: live jazz at Piano Bar Soho, London, on a swipe card with skip, tickets and save buttons
claim: "See what's on this weekend": Events tab with the Weekend filter, listings from the Ticketmaster Discovery API near the user, as in the screen (London, 40 events). Coverage depends on Ticketmaster in that country.

head: The story behind the place
alt: Place sheet for Treasurer's House, York: photo, Landmark and Historic tags, 423 m away, Wikipedia history, address and hours
where: /place/w241061247 (Treasurer's House, York) in the Android app's view: a production build with isNative() true, so it opens as the in-app sheet
claim: "The story behind the place": place pages show the Wikipedia/Wikidata history when one exists, as for Treasurer's House in the screen. Not every place has one, so the caption says "the place", not "every place".

head: A town's highlights on one page
alt: Town guide for Canterbury listing the cathedral, Eastbridge Hospital, the Beaney, St Augustine's Abbey and museums
claim: "A town's highlights on one page": the screen is one scrolling page for Canterbury listing its top-ranked places (sights, museums, theatres; the in-app guide shows up to 24, src/pages/TownPage.jsx PER_TOWN = 24) with category filters. No claim about every place or every town.

head: Find any saved place in seconds
alt: Saved places searched for "museum": York Army Museum and Barley Hall, each with a Go button
where: Saved tab, search "museum", guest session with seven saved places in York
claim: "In seconds": the saved-places search filters on the phone as you type, with no network call (src/utils/placeSearch.js); "museum" matches three of the seven saved places; two are visible on screen.
